confirm.title: Remove expired event
confirm.description:
**{event_name}** expired on **{expiry_date}**.

Before confirming: check if any dashboards, automations or scripts reference this event's entities — they will stop working after removal.

Press Submit to permanently remove this event and all its entities.

date_order_invalid.title: Trip date order invalid: {event_name}
date_order_invalid.description:
The entity-sourced end date (**{end_date}**) is before the start date (**{start_date}**) for **{event_name}**.

All sensors for this trip are currently unavailable. Update the source entities so that the end date is after the start date to resolve this issue automatically.

entity_source_deleted.title: Date source entity removed: {name}
entity_source_deleted.description:
The entity **{entity_id}** used as a date source for **{name}** has been removed from Home Assistant.

All sensors for this event are currently unavailable. To resolve this issue, open the event's settings and either choose a different entity, enter a fixed date, or delete the event.

create_event.name: Create event
create_event.description: Creates a WhenHub event. Custom pattern events can only be created in the user interface.

name.name: Name
name.description: Name of the event. Becomes the device name.

auto_rename.name: Rename on conflict
auto_rename.description: Appends a number when the name is already taken instead of failing.

start_date.name: Start date
start_date.description: Start date of a trip in the format YYYY-MM-DD. Cannot be combined with a start date entity.

end_date.name: End date
end_date.description: End date of a trip in the format YYYY-MM-DD. Cannot be combined with an end date entity.

target_date.name: Date
target_date.description: Date of a milestone, or the original date of an anniversary, in the format YYYY-MM-DD.

start_date_entity.name: Start date entity
start_date_entity.description: Entity that provides the start date. Needs device class date or timestamp.

end_date_entity.name: End date entity
end_date_entity.description: Entity that provides the end date. Needs device class date or timestamp.

target_date_entity.name: Date entity
target_date_entity.description: Entity that provides the date. Needs device class date or timestamp.

special_type.name: Holiday
special_type.description: Holiday tracked by a special event.

dst_region.name: Region
dst_region.description: Region whose daylight saving time changes are tracked.

dst_type.name: Change
dst_type.description: Which daylight saving time change to track.

image_path.name: Image path
image_path.description: Path or URL of an image for this event.

url.name: URL
url.description: Link shown by the URL sensor.

memo.name: Memo
memo.description: Markdown text shown by the memo sensor.

notify_on_expiry.name: Notify when expired
notify_on_expiry.description: Reports an expired event via Repairs. Only for trips and milestones.

update_event.name: Update event
update_event.description: Changes fields of an existing WhenHub event and reloads it. Only the fields you pass are changed.

device_id.name: Event
device_id.description: The event to change. Every WhenHub event is a device.

name.name: Name
name.description: New name of the event. Entity IDs stay unchanged.

replace_date_source.name: Replace entity source
replace_date_source.description: Allows a fixed date to replace a date that currently comes from an entity.

start_date.name: Start date
start_date.description: New start date of a trip in the format YYYY-MM-DD.

end_date.name: End date
end_date.description: New end date of a trip in the format YYYY-MM-DD.

target_date.name: Date
target_date.description: New date of a milestone or anniversary in the format YYYY-MM-DD.

start_date_entity.name: Start date entity
start_date_entity.description: Switches the start date to this entity. Needs device class date or timestamp.

end_date_entity.name: End date entity
end_date_entity.description: Switches the end date to this entity. Needs device class date or timestamp.

target_date_entity.name: Date entity
target_date_entity.description: Switches the date to this entity. Needs device class date or timestamp.

special_type.name: Holiday
special_type.description: New holiday for a special event.

dst_region.name: Region
dst_region.description: New region for a daylight saving time event.

dst_type.name: Change
dst_type.description: New change tracked by a daylight saving time event.

image_path.name: Image path
image_path.description: New image path. An empty value removes the current one.

url.name: URL
url.description: New link. An empty value removes the URL sensor.

memo.name: Memo
memo.description: New memo text. An empty value removes the memo sensor.

notify_on_expiry.name: Notify when expired
notify_on_expiry.description: Reports an expired event via Repairs. Only for trips, milestones and custom patterns with an end condition.

delete_event.name: Delete event
delete_event.description: Removes a WhenHub event including its device and all its entities. There is no confirmation and no undo.

device_id.name: Event
device_id.description: The event to remove. Every WhenHub event is a device.

device_not_whenhub.message: Device {device_id} does not belong to WhenHub.

calendar_not_supported.message: Device {device_id} is a WhenHub calendar. The event services only work on events.

name_exists.message: An event named {name} already exists. Set auto_rename to true or choose another name.

invalid_dates.message: The end date must be after the start date.

invalid_date_format.message: {value} is not a valid date for {field}. Use the format YYYY-MM-DD.

missing_field.message: The field {field} is required for event type {event_type}.

field_not_allowed.message: The field {field} cannot be used with event type {event_type}.

entity_wrong_device_class.message: Entity {entity_id} needs device class 'date' or 'timestamp' to be used as a date source.

date_source_active.message: The field {field} currently comes from entity {entity_id}. Set replace_date_source to true to store a fixed date instead.

notify_not_supported.message: notify_on_expiry is not available for event type {event_type}. Only trips, milestones and custom patterns with an end condition can expire.
